entities.title: csharp-indexer
entities.summary: A single-file MCP server, written in C#, that answers code questions for coding agents over one or more git work trees, backed by a per-user daemon that keeps an index current; zazzle also asks that daemon for terse views of C# files.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole tool: the project in src/, the xunit tests in tests/, the build settings both share (Directory.Build.props, including the 0.0.0-dev version a release replaces with its tag's) and the README a person reads to install and use it. It has its own build (dotnet) and its own CI stage (dotnet), apart from the repository's Rust tools and the C invoker, but ships inside the same v* release as them.
boundaries: Released by release.sh in the continuous_integration_and_delivery repository together with the other tools, when the owner runs it with a bump or a version, and built with that release's version: gzipped per macOS CPU type in the macOS tarball and the zazzle Homebrew formula, plain in the Linux tarballs (delivery.json). CI is recorded in .dev/pipeline.json, and the release pipeline, tarballs, formula and version scripts in release/.dev.
Its daemon socket is also used by daemon (src/macos/daemon/), which asks for the view tool when zazzle reads a .cs file; that client's code is documented there.

zazzle is the agents' front door for reading, searching and editing files: init registers daemon's MCP server beside the indexer's, and the redirect hook names zazzle's tools. zazzle itself is documented in src/macos/daemon/ and src/macos/zazzle/.
Code rules for this folder are in src/macos/csharp-style.md.
